title: geum sylvaticum subsp. inclinatum
intro: Geum sylvaticum subsp. inclinatum, commonly known as the woodland avens, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from digestive issues, such as diarrhea and ulcers, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of woodland avens include soothing gastrointestinal irritations, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
